besáronle: besar + le — they kissed him (preterite besaron + enclitic le; besar las manos, the formal courtesy owed to a lord)
las: el/la — the (fem. pl.); them (fem. object pronoun)
manos: mano — hand (pl.); dar las manos = the handclasp that makes an agreement binding · a las manos 'for the hands' (pidió agua a las manos 'asked for water to wash his hands'); bolver las manos 'to ply the hands', busy eating · also a las manos tomar 'to take by the hand' (a las manos les tomó, Pidal 'los tomó de la mano')
la: el/la — the (fem.); her/it (object pronoun) · also la que 'the one that' (Çelfa la que dizen de Canal 'Çelfa, the one they call of the Canal')
e: e — and (= modern y) · also aver — I have (1st sg. present, apocopated form of he, perfect auxiliary: Espeso e el oro, 'I have spent the gold') · also aver — 'I will', the future auxiliary in a split future (quitarvos e … darvos e de mano 'I will free you … I will let you go'; = vos quitaré, vos daré) · also the full verb 'I have' (el sabor que dend e 'the delight I have of it')
de: de — of, from · also de — by (the agent with a passive participle; = por) · also de — 'by (night)' (de noch), partitive 'of, among' (quinze moros … de los que alcançava; pocas de gentes), 'as' (de ganançia 'as booty'), 'from outside' (de fuera), 'on the right' (de diestro) · also 'about, concerning' (de mí non digan mal 'let them not speak ill of me') · also de — 'as if in' (commo de arrancada 'as if in rout'); 'in the manner of' (de guisa 'in such a way'); 'of, among' (de bivos pocos 'of the living few'); nominalized infinitive (del prender 'of the taking') · also de — 'with' of manner (de fuertes coraçones 'with stout hearts'); 'on' (de pie 'on foot'); 'from' of side (della e della part 'from both sides'); de cabo 'anew' (de + cabo, 'again'); de suso de 'above'; seños … de seños colpes 'with one blow each' · also de — 'in respect of' after an adjective (sobejana de mala 'exceedingly bad'); 'with regard to, about' (me plaze de mio Çid 'I am pleased about the Cid'); 'from, at the hand of' (de señor non ha graçia 'he gets no favor from a lord'); 'from' of origin (de moros fo 'it came from Moors'); 'at' of manner (de vagar 'at leisure', de + the noun vagar) · also de’ — Pidal's de’llaño, read as del llaño 'of the plain' (the article's l run into the ll; a reading, not certain) · de + infinitive after an adjective (de ir somos guisados 'we are ready to go') · also de + infinitive after a verb: començar de 'to begin to' (compeçó de fablar 'he began to speak'), piénssanse de 'set about' (piénssanse de armar), aver de 'to have to' (lo que ha de far 'what he has to do') · also de — 'within' of a time limit (De aquestos quinze días, most likely 'within these fifteen days'; sense uncertain); de veluntad 'willingly'; de + superlative partitive (de los mejores guarnimientos 'of the best equipment')
quien: quien — who, whom (relative pronoun, also with a plural antecedent; = quien, quienes) · also quien — 'whoever, he who' (quien quiere perder cueta 'whoever wishes to lose distress'); interrogative 'who?' (¿quien vos lo podrie contar? 'who could tell it you?'; = quién)
son: seer — they are (3rd pl.) · also son — perfect auxiliary of intransitives and passive auxiliary (todos son exidos 'have all gone out'; nombrados son; son derramadas 'are scattered')
grado: grado — thanks (grado a … 'thanks be to …') · also grado — will, good will (de grado 'willingly, gladly'; de grado non avrié nada, 'of good will there would be nothing to be had') · en grado tener 'to be thankful for' (en grado vos lo tengo 'I thank you for it')
al: a + el — to the; al menos 'even the least' · also a + el standing for a + la before a feminine noun beginning with a vowel (al espada = a la espada) · also al — 'other thing, the rest' (neuter, Latin alius; de lo al non pienssan nada 'of anything else they think nothing'; distinct from a + el) · also a + el before an infinitive 'on, upon' (al exir de Salón 'on leaving the Jalón'; = al salir) · al 'the other thing, the rest' in al feredes adelant 'the rest you will do later' · also por al 'otherwise, for any other reason' (non passará por al 'it will not be otherwise'); a mí mandedes al 'order me something else', give me another charge (the likelier reading of a terse line)
a: a — to, at · also aver — he/she has (3rd sg. present, h-less spelling of ha, as in el rey me a ayrado = el rey me ha airado) · personal a before a direct object (salvest a Jonás; a ti adoro); a + inf. 'to, about to' (tornólas a catar); a tan grand sabor 'with so great pleasure'; a ojo 'in plain sight' · also a — 'into' (sacar a çelada 'to lure into ambush'); 'at, in' (a la çaga 'at the rear'); 'against' (dar salto a la çaga); dative 'to' (a mí dedes); haber a + inf. 'have to' (lo han a far); a + noun of direction (adeliñava a la puerta 'made for the gate') · impersonal 'there is' (aver; es dia a de plazo 'there is (only) a day of the term', the most likely reading of a hard line); ha as auxiliary set after the participle (soñado a 'he has dreamt') · also 'on, at (a time)' (a tercer dia 'on the third day') · also a — 'has' before the participle, agreeing with the object (la lança a quebrada 'he has broken the lance'; a menester 'has need of'); a + dative of the person affected (a Minaya matáronle el cavallo 'they killed Minaya's horse') · a — 'as, for' (tóvoslo a grand fonta 'he took it as a great affront') · also a — 'with' of instrument (a dientes las tomó 'with his teeth he took them'; = con)
vos: vos — you (object pronoun, polite/plural) · also subject 'you' (vos, que por mí dexades 'you who leave for my sake'); dative 'to you' (dar vos quiero vuestra part) · also reflexive/ethic 'you (yourselves)' (id vos en algara 'go off on a raid'); dative with an impersonal sense (si cueta vos fore 'if need befall you')
çid: Çid — the Cid, 'lord' (Arabic sīdī 'my lord'; pronounced Tsid)
todo: todo — all, every (de todo conducho, 'with every kind of provision')
lo: lo — him, it (object pronoun) · lo que perdedes 'that which you lose' (neuter antecedent of the relative) · also lo — neuter article 'what is' (lo to 'what is yours'); pleonastic 'it' (lo an, lo han a far; por tal lo faze 'for that reason he does it')
que: que — that, who, which; for · also por que — because, since (= porque) · por que — by which, whereby (por que más valdrá 'whereby he will be worth more') · also que — 'so that, lest' introducing purpose/result (que por miedo non dexen nada; por tal lo faze … que no lo ventasse nadi); after después/mientra 'after, while' (después que, mientra que) · also que — than, after a comparative (mas le vienen … que nos le van 'more come to him than leave him') · also que — what (indirect interrogative; dezir vos he que faze 'I shall tell you what he does'; = qué)
feches: fazer — you do (present 2nd pl., a reduced form of fazedes; esto feches agora 'this you do now'; the sense is clear, the exact derivation less so; = hacéis)
es: seer — it is (present 3rd sg.) · also ser as perfect auxiliary of intransitives (exido es 'has gone out') and passive auxiliary (la tienda es cogida) · also es — that (apocopated esse = ese, demonstrative; en es alcaz 'in that pursuit', por es logar 'through that place')
buena: bueno — good (fem.); en buen(a) '(born/girded) in a good hour' — the poem's honorific formula
guisa: guisa — manner, fashion; a guisa de 'in the fashion of' · a vuestra guisa 'as you see fit, in your own way' (prended a vuestra guisa 'take as you please') · also de guisa que 'in such a way that' (de guisa irán por ellas que … 'in such a manner will they go for them that …'; = de modo que) · also a fea guisa 'in a shameful fashion' (sácanlos de las huertas mucho a fea guisa 'they drive them out most shamefully')
en: en — in, into, on · en — of it, thence (= ende; por en avemos qué fablar 'of which we have to speak') · also en — 'as' (en paria 'as tribute'); en essora 'at that moment' · also en — 'among' (en todos los sos 'among all his men') · also en + infinitive 'in (doing)' (en levarlo adelant 'in carrying it forward'); en çinco días 'in five days'
nos: nos — we (subject pronoun; = nosotros) · also nos — us, to us (object pronoun; atorgar nos hedes 'you will grant us') · also reflexive 'ourselves' (nos partimos 'we part'); dative (la missa nos dirá 'will say for us') · also nos' — non + se (aun nos' van del campo 'they are still not leaving the field'; the apostrophe marks the elision) · also nos — non + se, written without apostrophe (nin amigo a amigo nos pueden consolar 'nor can friend console friend'; mas le vienen … que nos le van 'more come to him than leave him', the no redundant after the comparison)
bien: bien — well · bien — good, benefit (noun; algún bien vos pueda far 'some good I may do you') · bien — very, quite, intensifying an adverb (bien çerca del agua 'very near the water')
seremos: seer — we shall be (future 1st pl.; = seremos)
doña: doña — lady (title; Latin domina, fem. of don)
digo: dezir — I say (present 1st sg.; yo non vos digo nada 'I say nothing to you'; = digo)
don: don — don, lord (honorific title) · also don — gift (noun; en don 'as a gift') · also don — from where, whence (= donde, de onde; Castejón don abremos grand enpara 'Castejón, from which we shall have great protection') · 'whereof, with which' (Pidal 'de lo cual'; don yo sea pagado 'whereof I may be satisfied') · also don — when, where (= donde, of time; Don llegan los otros 'when the others come up')
elvira: Elvira — Elvira, one of the Cid's two daughters (doña Elvira, also printed don Elvira; = Elvira)
sol: sol — sun · also 'even, so much as' (sol non 'not even'; sol non será penssado 'it will not even be thought of') · also sol — so + l, 'under the' (so 'under', Latin sub, + el before a vowel): del sol espada 'from under the sword' (the likeliest reading; the construction is uncertain) · also Sol — doña Sol, one of the Cid's two daughters (personal name)
deste: de + este — of this, from this (contraction; deste pan 'of this bread', partitive 'some of'; = de este)
casamiento: casamiento — marriage, match, wedding alliance (= casamiento)
creçremos: creçer — we shall grow (syncopated future 1st pl.; creçremos en rictad 'we shall grow in wealth'; = creceremos)
onor: onor — estate, lordship: the lands and rank held of a lord (fem.; creçer en onor 'to grow in lands and lordship'; tollida la onor 'the estate taken away'; = honor in its old sense, heredad, señorío; distinct from ondra 'honour')
mas: mas — but · also mas — 'most' (superlative, = más; en todo lo mas alto 'on the very highest part') · also mas — 'more' comparative (que es mas ondrada 'which is more honored'; = más)
sabet: saber — know, mark you (imperative 2nd pl., sabed; sabet = sabed; epic tag addressed to the audience)
verdad: verdad — truth (dezir vos he la verdad 'I shall tell you the truth'; = verdad) · also non será verdad — 'it shall not be so' (Pidal: 'esto no será así'; esto non será verdad)
ha: aver — he has (3rd sg. present; = ha) · ha — to (a with h-, aver a + inf. 'will, must': lo an todos ha far 'all are to do it'); aver — has, possesses (las fijas que ha 'the daughters she has') · also ha — future ending after infinitive + clitics, the split future (tornar nos la ha 'he will give it back to us'; = nos la tornará) · also ha — there is, there are (impersonal; dos señas ha cabdales 'there are two chief banners'; = hay) · also ha — perfect auxiliary 'has' before the participle (ha vendido 'has sold'; fechos los ha ricos 'has made them rich') · also 'has, gets' (de señor non ha graçia 'he has no favor from a lord') · also ha de + inf. 'is to' (que los ha de aguardar 'who is to attend them'; aver de + infinitive, = ha de) · also non ha qui + inf. — 'there is no one to' (impersonal ha 'there is'; non ha qui tomallos 'there is no one to take them'; = no hay quien) · also ha — of time elapsed, 'it is, it has been' (Pocos días ha … que 'it is a few days since'; = hace)
el: el — the (masc.) · also el — 'he who' before a relative (el qui quisiere, el que es sobre Fenares); el before a fem. noun beginning with a vowel (el espada = la espada; el algara = la algara) · also el de + place name 'he of, the one from' (mio Çid el de Bivar)
mio: mio — my (unstressed possessive; mio Çid 'my lord Cid')
firme: firme — firm; used adverbially, 'firmly, securely' (= firmemente) · also firme' — firmes, 'firm, steadfast' (adjective plural, final s dropped; firme' son los moros 'the Moors are firm', i.e. still holding their ground)
mientre: mientre — adverb-forming suffix, 'in a manner' (Latin mente; fuerte mientre = fuertemente)
coraçón: coraçón — heart (= corazón) · also por coraçón 'willingly, heartily, with a will' (lo an por coraçón) · also de coraçón 'heartily, with a will' (adóbanse de coraçón 'they arm with a will')
nulla: nulla — no, any (Latin nulla; fem. sg. after a negative or 'without'; a nulla part 'from no side, anywhere'; si'nulla dubda 'without any fear' (or 'doubt'); = ninguna)
no: no — not (variant spelling of non) · also nos — to us (nos elided before lo: no' lo, 'to us it')
amas: amos — both (fem. pl., Latin ambas; las manos amas 'both hands'; = ambas)
me: me — me, to me · also reflexive 'myself' (fata que yo me pague 'until I am satisfied')
él: él — he (stressed subject pronoun) · also él — 'him, it' after a preposition, of a thing (a él vino; en él fincaredes 'in it', i.e. in Castejón)
casa: casa — house; also settlement, town (Burgos la casa 'the town of Burgos')
ca: ca — for, because (Latin quia) · ca — perhaps 'but, whereas' (el uno es en paradiso, ca el otro non entró allá; the sense is uncertain) · also ca non — 'and not that' (Pidal 'y no que'; cuédanse que es almofalla, ca non vienen con mandado 'they think it is an army, and not that they come with a message')
penssaron: pensar — they set about (preterite 3rd pl.; pensar de + inf. 'to set about doing'; penssaron de andar 'they set about marching'; = pensaron)
adobar: adobar — to equip, make ready (infinitive; = adobar, aderezar)
essora: essora — then, at that moment (ess' + ora; en essora 'at that moment'; = entonces)
palaçio: palaçio — hall, palace; the main room of a house (= palacio)
por: por — through, along, by, for · purpose, 'in order to' (por el reyno quitar 'to quit the kingdom'); por + inf. 'yet to be done' (tres an por troçir 'three remain to pass'); 'for, on behalf of' (por mio Çid) · also por — 'out of, because of' (por miedo 'through fear'); 'for (that reason)' (por tal lo faze 'he does it for that reason'); 'by way of' (por Guadalfajara); por + noun 'for the sake of' ; por coraçón 'willingly' · also 'for (a price)' (por quanto serié conprada 'for how much it would be bought'); 'by means of' (por carta 'by writ'); 'through, thanks to' (por mí ganaredes 'through me you will gain') · also por — 'on, during (a time)' (por aquesta mañana 'this morning'); 'by way of, through' (por medio de la llaña 'through the middle of the plain') · also por — 'in' after fiar (yo fío por Dios 'I trust in God') · also por — 'to fetch, for' after enbiar/ir (enbiaré por ellas, irán por ellas 'I shall send for them', 'they will go for them'); por cuenta 'by count, in a count' · also por — as (por heredad 'as a possession') · also por — 'about, after' with preguntar (por el rey tómanse a preguntar 'they begin to ask after the king'); por + infinitive 'for … to' (por … vençer reyes, 'for … to defeat kings')
suso: suso — up, above (adverb, Latin sursum; de suso de los arzones 'above the saddle-bows'; no modern equivalent, closest arriba)
tanta: tanto — so many, so much (fem. sg. used collectively; tanta adágara 'so many a shield'; = tanta)
tanto: tanto — so much, so great · tanto quanto + subjunctive 'as long as' (tanto quanto yo biva 'as long as I live') · also tanto — 'so many' before a masc. sg. noun used collectively (tanto palafré, tanto buen pendón 'so many a palfrey, so many a good banner'; = tantos)
sabor: sabor — pleasure, wish; a so sabor 'at his (their) pleasure' · also por sabor de 'out of a wish to please, for the sake of' (por sabor de mio Çid 'to please the Cid')
sos: so — his, her, their (= modern sus) · also los sos 'his own men' (possessive with article as noun; en todos los sos 'among all his men')
juntados: juntar — gathered, assembled (past part. masc. pl.; son juntados 'have assembled'; = juntados)
iffantes: infante — child, young child (pl., spelt with ff; = niños); also a young man of noble birth
carrión: Carrión — Carrión de los Condes, town in Palencia, seat of the counts of Carrión (= Carrión)
enbiaron: enbiar — they sent (preterite 3rd pl.; al rey de Valençia enbiaron con mensaje 'they sent to the king of Valencia with a message'; = enviaron)
cavalgan: cavalgar — they ride, mount (present 3rd pl.; = cabalgan)
los: el — the (masc. pl.); them (object pronoun) · also los que 'those who' (demonstrative use before a relative); los — him, them as object of consejar (commo los consejava 'as he advised them') · also los de 'those of' (con los de Castejón 'with the men of Castejón')
adelant: adelant — onward, ahead (apocopated adverb; = adelante) · also adelant — henceforth, from now on (of time; mio reyno adelant 'the rest of my reign'); ir adelant 'to prosper, go forward' (las nuevas del Çid mucho van adelant; = prosperar)
adobados: adobar — equipped, ready (past part. masc. pl.; todos son adobados 'all are ready'; = pertrechados, aderezados)
dios: Dios — God · also Dios! — interjection of wonder (Dios, cómmo se alabavan! 'God, how they boasted!')
qué: qué — what a …! (exclamative) · also qué — what? which? (interrogative pronoun/adjective, as in de qué será pagado, 'with what will he be satisfied') · indirect: que non sabe qué se far '(so that) she knows not what to do'; avemos qué fablar 'we have something to speak of' · also qué — how (exclamative before an adverb: qué bien pago 'how well he paid')
elle: elle — he (old form of él, Latin ille; elle fizo = él hizo; Pidal restores el[le])
delant: delant — ahead, in front (apocopated adverb; = delante)
se: se — himself/herself/itself (reflexive pronoun) · also se — passive 'is, are' (cómmo se gana el pan 'how bread is earned'; = se, passive-reflexive) · also se — ethic/intensive dative 'for himself, with his own eyes' (él se lo vío con los ojos 'he saw it himself')
le: le — to him, him (dative pronoun) · also le — him, as direct object (leísmo; si ellos le prenden 'if they take him'); dative (non se le dava 'did not surrender to him') · also le — dative of separation, 'from him' (que nos le parte de so braço 'who does not leave his side'); dative 'for him' (ques le non spidiés 'who does not take leave of him')
ivan: ir — they were going (imperfect 3rd pl.; ivan posar 'they were going to lodge'; = iban) · also ir + gerund, 'were coming to, gradually' (ya lo ivan provando 'they were by now coming to experience it')
posar: posar — to lodge, halt for the night (infinitive; = posar)
un: uno — a, one (apocopated masc. before a noun)
están: estar — they are, stay (present 3rd pl.; = están) · also progressive auxiliary with a gerund (bendiziéndol están 'they are blessing him')
parando: parar — leaving, putting in a state (gerund; las va parando negras 'he goes leaving them black'; = parando, closest dejando)
ora: hora — hour (= hora); en buen ora, part of the poem's honorific birth-formula, 'born in a good hour' · al ora 'at that very hour, then' (en ti crovo al ora) · also una grant ora — a long while (Pidal 'un gran rato'; = un buen rato)
nasco: nacer — he was born (strong preterite 3rd sg.; = nació)
campeador: Campeador — the Battler, the Champion (the Cid's epithet, from campo 'field of battle')
pues: pues — since, then; pues que 'since' · also pues + future subjunctive 'when, once' (pues fueren en vuestro poder 'when they are in your power')
fazer: fazer — to make, do, dig (infinitive; mandó fazer 'ordered made'; = hacer)
avemos: aver — we have (present 1st pl.; = hemos) · avemos de + inf. 'we must' (mucho avemos de andar 'we have far to go'); avemos qué fablar 'we have something to speak of' · also perfect auxiliary aver + participle (avemos preso 'we have taken')
venit: venir — come! (imperative 2nd pl., -t for -d like sabet; id e venit 'go and come'; = venid)
acá: acá — here, hither (adverb; exidos somos acá 'we have come out to here'; = acá)
álbar: Álbar — Álvar (personal name, Álbar Fáñez; = Álvar)
mano: mano — hand (sg.); en vuestra mano = 'in your keeping' · a mano 'by hand, hand-picked' (escollechos a mano 'chosen by hand') · dar de mano 'to let go, release' (Pidal 'soltar'; darvos e de mano 'I will let you go')
gelo: ge + lo — it to him/them (ge, ancestor of modern se, + lo; = se lo)
he: aver — I have (1st sg. present; perfect auxiliary, = he, and the auxiliary of the split future, e.g. doblar vos he) · also he — and (a spelling of e; he de fijas de mio Çid 'and of the daughters of my Çid')
mandado: mandado — message, news, word (noun; from mandar 'to send, order') · also mandado — order, command (mandado de so señor 'the lord's command'); fazer mandado 'to send word' · also past part. 'granted, assigned' (el quinto que me avedes mandado 'the fifth you have granted me')
nada: nada — nothing; por nada 'for anything (in the world)'
quanto: quanto — as much as, whatever (= cuanto) · quanto ella mejor sabe 'as best she can' (quanto + comparative 'as much as') · also 'how much' (por quanto serié conprada 'for how much it would be bought'); 'as far/fast as' (quanto pueden andar) · tanto quanto 'as long as'; por quanto … ha 'for all that there is' (por quanto en el mundo ha) · also en quanto — 'as far as, insofar as' (En quanto podemos 'as far as we are able'; = en cuanto)
ay: aver — there is, there are (impersonal, present of aver, with y 'there' attached; algunos ay de más 'there are some more besides'; = hay)
parado: parar — settled, arranged (past part.; el pleyto a parado = 'has settled the agreement')
ifantes: infante — young nobleman, son of a noble house (pl., spelt Ifantes; = infantes)
dadlas: dar + las — give them (imperative 2nd pl. dad + las; dadlas a qui quisiéredes vos 'give them to whom you wish'; = dadlas)
prendan: prender — let them take (present subjunctive 3rd pl.; prendan el rastro 'let them take the trail'; = prendan)
dixo: dezir — he/she said (strong preterite; x = sh-sound; = dijo)
minaya: Minaya — the title by which the Cid's kinsman Álvar Fáñez is called, usually explained as mi + anaya 'my brother'
faré: fazer — I shall make (future 1st sg.; = haré)
va: ir — he/she goes (present 3rd sg.; = va); ir + gerund, 'to be (gradually) doing' · ir + infinitive 'goes to' (la manol va besar 'goes to kiss his hand', el Duero va passar 'goes to cross the Duero') · also va — 'there is, goes on' impersonal (¡Qué priessa va en los moros! 'what a stir there is among the Moors!')
afevos: afevos — behold, here is/are (presentative, a + fe + vos; = he aquí, ahí tenéis)
sodes: seer — you are (2nd pl. present, used respectfully to one person; = sois; old -edes ending, cf. odredes, vedes, catedes)
del: de + el — of the (contraction) · also del standing for de + la before a feminine noun beginning with a vowel (del albergada = de la albergada) · also del — 'from, for, because of' (cause; del gozo 'from the joy'; del çerviçio 'for the service')
ovo: aver — he had (strong preterite 3rd sg.; = hubo; here perfect auxiliary, ovo bastidos = 'he had furnished') · ovo de + inf., little more than a plain past (las manos se ovo de untar 'his hands were smeared'); dont a ojo los ovo 'as soon as he had them in sight'
dovos: dar + vos — I give you (present 1st sg. do + enclitic vos; = os doy)
dalgo: de + algo — of something; fija dalgo 'daughter of something', well-born (= hidalga)
recabdo: recabdo — care, precaution, strict order (= recaudo) · also recabdo — business secured, a sure outcome (con todo buen recabdo 'with everything well in hand') · recabdo — account, reckoning (oro e plata que non saben recabdo 'gold and silver past all reckoning') · also con recabdo — within bounds, under control (non es con recabdo el dolor de Valençia 'the grief of Valencia is past all bounds') · also todo el recabdo está 'every precaution is taken' (Pidal: 'hay toda clase de precauciones'; en Medina todo el recabdo está)
d: de — of, with (elided form of de before a vowel, d'arena = de arena) · de — from (unos d'otros 'one from another') · also d — 'about, concerning' (D' iffantes de Carrión yo vos quiero contar 'of the Infantes of Carrión I wish to tell you'; = de)
amor: amor — love; por amor de 'for the love of' · also amor — favour, grace of a lord toward his vassal (davos su amor 'he gives you his favour'; del rey he su amor 'I have the king's favour') · also amor — good will, consent (of a vassal to his lord's act; con vuestro amor 'with your good will')
su: su — his, her, its · also su — their (aquella su almofalla 'that host of theirs')
van: ir — they go (present 3rd pl.) · also ir + gerund 'keep going' (passando van 'they go on passing') · also ir + infinitive 'go to' (le van çercar 'they go to besiege him'; se van tornar 'they go back')
ovieron: aver — they had, they got (strong preterite of aver; = hubieron) · also ovieron a + inf. — 'they had to, were obliged to' (ovieron a enbiar 'they had to send'; = tuvieron que enviar) · also ovieron de + inf. — 'they came to, they did' (ovieron de arrancarlos 'they routed them'; aver de + infinitive)
salieron: salir — they went out (preterite 3rd pl.; = salieron)
santa: santo — Saint (fem.); Santa María, the cathedral of Burgos · santa — holy (adjective; santa Trinidad 'the Holy Trinity', santa María madre 'holy Mary, (thy) mother', the Virgin) · also Santa María — the church (cathedral) of Valencia, Don Jerome's see, where the drums are to be hung (colgar los han en Santa María madre del Criador)
maría: María — Mary; Santa María, the cathedral of Burgos · also Santa María — Albarracín (Teruel), held by the Aben Razín (Pidal; por Santa María vos vayades passar) · also Santa María — the church (cathedral) of Valencia, Don Jerome's see (colgar los han en Santa María)
priessa: priessa — haste, bustle (a una priessa 'all in one bustle'; = prisa) · also a priessa — 'quickly, in haste' (adverbial; a priessa espoloneavan 'they spurred in haste')
jerome: Jerome — Jerónimo, the Cid's bishop of Valencia (Pidal restores Jero[me], 'don Jerome'; = Jerónimo)
vistiós: vestir + se — he put on (preterite 3rd sg. vistió + reflexive se reduced to -s; vistiós el sobregonel 'he put on the sobregonel'; = se vistió)
salir: salir — to come out, emerge (infinitive; salir vermejos en sangre 'to come out red with blood'; = salir)
valençia: Valençia — Valencia, the Moorish kingdom and city whose king Tamín is addressed (= Valencia)
fuera: fuera — outside, out of doors (adverb; de fuera 'outside, from outside'; = fuera)
dieron: dar — they gave (preterite 3rd pl.; dar salto 'to leap')
salto: salto — leap, jump · also dash, sally (dar salto 'to make a sortie'; non osa ninguno dar salto a la çaga 'none dares to dash at the rearguard')
armas: arma — weapon, arms (pl.; armas de lidiar 'weapons for fighting'; en armas 'in arms, armed'; = armas) · also armas — men-at-arms, armed men (treynta mill de armas 'thirty thousand armed men')
mucho: mucho — much, greatly · also mucho — very, intensifying a predicate (mucho es mañana 'it is much too early, too soon') · also mas mucho — 'more' (mucho as a comparative = más: mas mucho fue provechosa 'was more profitable'; Pidal)
era: seer — it was (imperfect of seer = ser) · era + past part. 'had' (ser as pluperfect auxiliary with intransitives; Minaya assí era llegado 'Minaya had arrived')
pagado: pagar — satisfied, pleased; also paid (past part.; será pagado = 'he will be content with')
an: aver — they have (3rd pl. present of aver = han) · perfect auxiliary (passados los an 'they have passed'; la missa acabada la an 'they have finished'); an por troçir 'there remain to pass'; an ... ha far 'they have to do, are to do' · also future auxiliary after an infinitive, the split future (ve[e]rme an 'they will see me'; = me verán)
tórnanse: tornar + se — they turn back, return (present tornan + enclitic se; = se tornan, closest vuelven)
entrado: entrar — entered, gone in (past part.; f[o] entrado = 'had gone in', a ser + participle periphrasis)
fueron: seer/ir — they were (preterite 3rd pl., shared by ser and ir; todos fueron alegres 'all were glad'; = fueron)
bodas: boda — wedding, wedding feast (fem. pl.; en sus bodas 'in their wedding'; = bodas)
ondrado: ondrar — honored, esteemed (past part. as adjective, masc. sg.; rey ondrado 'honored king'; = honrado)
otro: otro — other, another (masc.; el otro 'the other'; = otro) · also otro día 'the next day'; lo otro 'the rest'
fizo: fazer — he made, did, caused (strong preterite 3rd sg.; fizo posar 'he made (them) halt'; = hizo)
fincar: fincar — to stay, remain (infinitive; = quedarse, closest quedar) · also fincar — to pitch, plant (tiendas a fincar 'to pitch tents'; = hincar)
tablados: tablado — a little castle of boards set up as a target, which knights struck with their lances to bring it down (pl.; tablados crebantavan 'they broke down the board castles'; Pidal 'castillejo de tablas'; = tablado, now 'stage, platform')
antes: antes — before; antes de 'before' · also antes que — 'before' (conjunction; antes quel prendan 'before they take him') · also antes — 'rather' (antes perderé el cuerpo 'rather shall I lose my body')
conplidos: conplido — complete, full (past part. used as adjective, masc. pl.; todos foron conplidos 'all were complete, at full strength'; = cumplidos, completos; the exact sense is somewhat uncertain)
çerca: çerca — near; here adverbial, çerca o tarde = 'sooner or later' (= cerca) · also çerca — siege, encirclement (noun; en çerca 'under siege'; = cerco) · also çercar — he besieges (present 3rd sg.; bien la çerca mio Çid 'my Çid besieges it well'; = cerca)
yas: ya + se — already … themselves (ya + reflexive se cut to s; yas mueven 'they are already moving'; = ya se)
fijos: fijo — son (masc. pl.; fijos dalgo 'sons of something', noblemen; = hijos) · also fijos — children, sons and daughters together (los yernos e las fijas todos vuestros fijos son)
rodrigo: Rodrigo — Rodrigo, the Cid's given name (= Rodrigo)
entre: entre — between, among; entre X e Y 'X and Y together'
palafrés: palafré — palfrey, riding horse (pl.; a gentle horse for ordinary riding rather than war; = palafrenes)
corredores: corredor — raider, outrider sent out to scour the country (masc. pl.; davan sus corredores 'he sent out his raiders'; = corredores, closest 'exploradores, incursores') · also corredor — swift, fast-running (adjective, of horses; cavallos gruessos e corredores 'stout, swift horses'; = veloces)
bestias: bestia — beast, mount (fem. pl.; riding/pack animals; = bestias)
sines: sines — without (= sin, with added -es; sines dubdança 'without hesitation')
mandados: mandado — message, news, report (pl.; here the tidings that spread; = mandados)
pelliçones: pelliçón — fur robe, pelisse (masc. pl.; a fur-lined garment; = pellizas)
largos: largo — abundant, ample, generous (masc. pl.; averes largos 'plentiful goods'; = largos)
foron: seer — they were (preterite 3rd pl., variant of fueron; = fueron) · also foron — they went (ir, which shares this preterite; F[o]ron los mandados a todas partes 'the messages went everywhere')
cuenta: cuenta — count, reckoning, account · also non son en cuenta 'they are not in the count': past counting, or not reckoned in (= no se cuentan)
averes: aver — goods, possessions, wealth (aver as noun, pl.)
monedados: monedar — coined, minted (past part. pl.; cf. monedado sg.)
cada: cada — each, every (= cada; a cada uno 'to each one')
uno: uno — one; en uno = 'together, as one' · el uno ... el otro 'the one ... the other' (el uno es en paradiso, ca el otro non entró) · also lo uno … lo otro 'one part … the other part' (neuter; lo uno adebdan e lo otro pagavan 'part they owe and part they paid')
sí: sí — so, thus (optative particle, Latin sic; sí el Criador vos salue 'so may the Creator save you'; = así, no modern use as a particle)
dados: dar — given, paid (past part. masc. pl.; dados foron 'were paid'; = dados)
qui: qui — he who, whoever (old relative pronoun, Latin qui; = quien) · also qui — who? (interrogative; ¿qui los podrié contar? 'who could count them?'; = quién) · also qui after a negative — 'anyone who, one to' (non ha qui tomallos 'there is nobody to take them'; = quien)
aver: aver — wealth, property, goods (noun use of aver, beside aver the verb 'to have') · also aver — to have (infinitive; aver … de + inf. 'to be bound to', split conditional aver vos lo iedes de far 'you would be bound to do it')
quiere: querer — he wants (present 3rd sg.; non lo quiere comer 'he will not eat it'; = quiere) · also 'is about to' (el março quiere entrar 'March is about to come in')
prender: prender — to seize, arrest (infinitive; = prender) · also prender — to take, accept (prender so don 'to take his gift'; = tomar, aceptar)
tornan: tornar — they turn, go back (present 3rd pl.; tornan de castigar 'they go back to instructing'; = tornan)
llegaron: llegar — they arrived (preterite 3rd pl.; llegaron las nuevas 'the news arrived'; = llegaron)
partiendo: partir — dividing, sharing out (gerund; partiendo estas ganançias 'sharing out this booty'; = repartiendo)
aquestos: aqueste — these (masc. pl., 'aqueste' = este with prefixed aque-; aquestos dos reyes 'these two kings'; = estos)
roy: Roy — Ruy, short for Rodrigo (Roy Díaz = Rodrigo Díaz, the Cid)
pagados: pagar — paid, satisfied (past part. masc. pl.; todos sodes pagados 'you are all satisfied'; = pagados)
parten: partir — they part, separate (present 3rd pl.; = parten)
dizen: dezir — they say, they call (present 3rd pl.; do dizen monte Calvarie 'where they call (it) Mount Calvary'; = dicen)
dellos: de + ellos — of them, from them (contraction)
aguisado: guisar — fitting, reasonable (past part. used as adj.; variant of guisado) · also ready, prepared (ser + part., impersonal: Ya es aguisado 'now all is arranged')
alegres: alegre — glad, happy (pl.; todos son alegres 'all are glad'; = alegres)
didago: Didago — Diego (Diego González, one of the two infantes of Carrión; = Diego)
ferrando: Ferrando — Fernando (Fernando González, the other infante of Carrión; = Fernando)
comde: conde — count (Pidal's co[m]de; al comde de Barçilona 'to the count of Barcelona'; = conde)
venidos: venir — come, become (past part. masc. pl. with the auxiliary seer; ricos son venidos 'have become rich'; = venidos)
y: y — and (rarer spelling of e) · also y — there (adverb, = i, Latin ibi; entraré y 'I shall enter there')
dos: dos — two · also do + se, 'when/where … (they)' (Dos fallan con los moros 'when they come upon the Moors', Pidal 'cuando se encuentran'; = cuando se encuentran)
les: les — to them · also les — 'from them', dative of removal or injury (les tollió el pan 'took the bread from them'; viédales exir 'forbids them to go out')
fazen: fazer — they make, give (present 3rd pl.; grand yantar le fazen 'they give him a great feast'; = hacen) · also fazerse — to become (cavalleros se fazen 'they become knights'; = se hacen) · also fazerse — passive 'are made' (las moradas cómmo se fazen 'how the dwellings are made'; sense of moradas uncertain)
sobejanos: sobejano — excessive, abundant beyond measure (masc. pl. adj.)
plega: plazer — may it please (present subjunctive 3rd sg.; plega a Dios 'may it please God'; = plazca)
padre: padre — father · el Padre santo, God the Father
santo: santo — holy, saint (masc. sg.; el Padre santo 'the holy Father', God)
ques: que + se — who ... themselves (que, relative pronoun, + reflexive se; los ques pudieron escapar 'those who managed to escape'; = los que se pudieron escapar) · also ques — qué + se, 'what … to' (interrogative que + se; non sabent ques far 'they know not what to do', as qué se far at v. 1155; no note in Pidal; = qué hacer) · also fata ques torne 'until he returns' (conjunction fata que + reflexive se; = hasta que se vuelva) · also ques — que + se, conjunction 'that' + reflexive (que otro dia … ques tornasse cada uno 'that next day … each should return'; = que se)
pague: pagar — (that) I be satisfied, paid (present subjunctive 1st sg., reflexive me pague; fata que yo me pague 'until I am satisfied'; = pague)
des: des — from (des día 'from that day', short for desde aquel día; des = desde; = desde)
o: o — or; also ó — where (interrogative, Latin ubi; ¿O sodes…? 'Where are you…?') · also o — where (relative adverb; o dizen Castejón 'which they call Castejón'; o el Campeador estava 'where the Campeador was'; = donde) · correlative 'either … or' (o me dexaredes … o … levaredes 'either you will leave me … or you will take away')
cantar: cantar — to sing; cantar missas 'to say masses' (infinitive)
aquis: aquí + se — here (aquí with the se of the following verb glued on as -s; Aquis conpieça 'here begins'; = aquí se comienza)
vala: valer — may he avail, protect (present subjunctive; vos vala 'may he keep you')
santos: santo — saint (masc. pl.); los sos santos 'his saints' · also adjective, holy (los santos padres 'the holy fathers')
